sections.Profile:
Vector Pinball's licensed game based on the 1960s Lost in Space television series sends the player through seven missions, from collecting the crew and mining fuel to timed Meteor and Monster drop-target modes, before a four-ball Lost in Space multiball. A screen under the lower playfield plays clips from the show.

- Manufacturer: Vector Pinball
- Years made: 2026
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: 2020s, Licensed, Space, Solid State, TV Show, Sci-Fi
